name: Styrenix Performance Materials Limited
summary: Styrenix Performance Materials Limited engages in the manufacture, trading, and sale of engineering thermoplastics in India. It offers ABS for injection moulding and extrusion use in various applications, such as automobile interiors and exteriors, household appliances, office equipment, and electronic devices for housing; and hight heat ABS used in automotive interior and exterior parts, radiator grills, rear mirror housing, spoilers and wheel covers, air vent, centre fascia, and instrument cluster applications under the ABSOLAC brand.
